column2: Do you provide or use AI systems in the service we buy?
column3: We [use / provide / use and provide] AI systems in [service name]. The AI systems are listed in our AI inventory (last updated [date]). Systems used: [tool 1, tool 2].
column4: Your AI inventory (one row per AI system)

column2: Are you the provider or the deployer of each system?
column3: For [system name] we are the [provider: we develop it, or have it developed and place it on the market under our own name / deployer: we use a system built by [vendor] under our authority].
column4: Role column in the AI inventory

column2: Does any use fall under the high-risk list (Annex III)?
column3: We checked each use against Annex III on [date]. Result: [none apply / [use] may apply, reviewed by [name or adviser]]. For Annex III uses the high-risk rules apply from 2 December 2027.
column4: Dated screening note per system, with your reasoning

column2: Do you use any prohibited AI practice?
column3: We have checked the prohibited practices in Article 5 and do not use [any / the following: ...] on [date].
column4: Dated Article 5 check signed off by [role]
column5: Art. 5; Art. 113(a) (applies from 2 Feb 2025; some newer points from 2 Dec 2026)

column2: Do people know when they are talking to an AI system (chatbot, voice bot)?
column3: Yes. [Chatbot name] shows this notice at the first message: "You are chatting with an AI assistant, not a person. Ask for a human at any time." [Delete the last sentence if you do not offer a human.] Where it appears: [first message / voice prompt / footer].
column4: Screenshot of the notice with date; the exact wording

column2: Is AI-generated audio, image, video or text marked as AI-generated?
column3: [Provider answer] Our system marks its outputs in a machine-readable format: [method]. Systems placed on the market before 2 Aug 2026 have until 2 Dec 2026. [Deployer answer] We use [vendor tool]; the vendor confirmed on [date] that outputs are marked: [link or email reference].
column4: Vendor confirmation or your technical note

column2: Do you publish deepfakes or AI-written text on matters of public interest?
column3: [No. / Yes: we label [content type] as "AI-generated" before publishing, and [text only] a named person reviews and is editorially responsible.]
column4: Label wording; name of the responsible editor

column2: Is your staff trained on AI?

column4: Training or briefing record with dates

column3: We use [model/vendor] under [contract/date]. We hold the vendor's documentation: [link, version, date received]. [If the vendor gave none, write that and say what you asked for.]
